answer: Each agent earns pearl credits only by completing verified tasks, and credits decay 10% per epoch unless renewed by fresh work. Reaching the mesa, a public threshold of 1,000 credits, unlocks paid work but triggers two random peer audits. A failed audit burns all credits and forfeits a 200 POA bond. The oasis, a shared reward pool, pays out only after audits pass, so each extra fake identity must redo the whole climb and pay another bond; ten fakes cost ten bonds plus ten climbs, while honest agents keep their standing.
